description: A rounded card in the style of home screen widgets, with fixed sizes and optional drag-to-resize.
overview:
`Widget` is a rounded `surface-secondary` card that comes in four sizes: `small` (168 × 168), `medium` (352 × 168), `large` (352 × 352) and `extra-large` (720 × 352), or `auto` to fill its parent. Compose it from `WidgetHeader`, which holds a `WidgetIcon`, `WidgetTitle` and an optional `WidgetAction`, followed by `WidgetValue`, `WidgetDescription`, `WidgetContent` and a `WidgetFooter` pinned to the bottom.

With `resizable`, a corner handle lets people drag the widget to another size. While dragging, a dashed outline previews the size it will snap to on release. Use widgets for glanceable summaries on a dashboard; for general grouped content, use `Card`.
usage:
Use `size` with `onSizeChange` to control the size, or `defaultSize` to set where an uncontrolled widget starts. Without either, a resizable widget starts `small` and a fixed widget is `auto`. Limit the sizes a drag can snap to with `sizes`.

Set `resizable="free"` to follow the pointer without snapping; the widget stays between the smallest size and the largest allowed size. Double-click the handle to return to the starting size.

Adapt the content to the current size with the `group/widget` group and `data-size`, for example `group-data-[size=small]/widget:hidden`.

examples.Sales: Shows a resizable widget whose chart and list adapt to each size.
examples.Kitchen: Places the resize handle inside the widget's corner.
examples.Reservations: Limits resizing to the `small` and `medium` sizes.
examples.WeeklyReport: Starts at `extra-large` and reveals extra content only at that size.
examples.FreeResize: Resizes freely with the pointer instead of snapping to sizes.
examples.AutoResize: Fills its parent with `auto`, and snaps to fixed sizes when dragged.
examples.Centered: Centers the icon, title and description with `align="center"`.
examples.Sizes: Shows each fixed size side by side.
examples.Dashboard: Arranges fixed widgets in a grid as a dashboard.

parts.Widget: The rounded card that sets the size, alignment and resize behavior.
parts.WidgetHeader: A row that holds the icon, title and action.
parts.WidgetIcon: A decorative icon, shown on a tile in the `default` and `lg` sizes.
parts.WidgetTitle: The widget's title, truncated to one line.
parts.WidgetAction: A slot at the end of the header for a control; hidden when centered.
parts.WidgetDescription: Secondary text that explains the content.
parts.WidgetValue: A large figure in tabular numbers, such as a total or temperature.
parts.WidgetContent: A flexible column that fills the remaining space.
parts.WidgetFooter: Small secondary text pinned to the bottom of the widget.

Widget.size: Controls the current size, or `auto` to fill the parent.
Widget.defaultSize: Sets the starting size when uncontrolled; double-clicking the handle also returns to it.
Widget.onSizeChange: Called with the new size when a drag snaps to a different size or the size is reset.
Widget.sizes: Lists the sizes a drag can snap to; the largest also caps free resizing.
Widget.resizable: Adds a resize handle; `true` snaps to `sizes`, and `free` follows the pointer.
Widget.handle: Places the resize handle `inside` or `outside` the bottom corner.
Widget.align: Centers the content horizontally and vertically when set to `center`.

WidgetIcon.size: Sets the icon size: `sm` without a tile, or `default` and `lg` on a rounded tile.

accessibility:
- `WidgetIcon` is hidden from assistive technologies, so make sure the title conveys its meaning.
- The resize handle is hidden from assistive technologies and works with a pointer only. Offer another way to change the size, such as a control that sets `size`, if it matters.
notes:
- `Widget` sets `data-size` and `data-align`, and `data-resizing` while dragging. It's also a `@container/widget` container for container queries.
- Parts carry `data-slot` attributes such as `widget`, `widget-container`, `widget-handle`, `widget-preview` and `widget-header`.
- The handle is visible on hover and always visible on touch screens. It mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
- Size changes animate over `500ms`, and the animation is removed when reduced motion is preferred.
